title: Rivian sues the US government for 'full refund' of Trump tariffs | TechCrunch
summary: Rivian has filed a lawsuit against the U.S. government in an attempt to claw back a “full refund” on tariffs it paid under President Trump’s “Liberation Day” taxes, which the Supreme Court later ruled unconstitutional.
